body:
**Open observation from MMR-30 (village trade bounds after a load).**

In a new generated game, each village is in its bound town's `Town.TradeBoundVillages` right after registration and still at the visible paused map (run 11432, both worlds).

After a cold-restart load of the same saves, the towns' `TradeBoundVillages` did **not** list their villages at `saved_game_loaded` (run 2244, `evidence/runtime/in-game/generated_save_load-2244.json`, both worlds, 4 villages).

`Village.Deserialize` (installed IL) removes and re-adds the trade-bound link on a saved-campaign replay, but only when `Bound.IsTown`. The campaign may also re-derive trade bounds after a load. It is unresolved whether vanilla rebuilds them later, or whether a generated load loses them.

The registry (MMR-30) therefore checks the trade-bound link only at new-game registration. Village trade and economy (MMR-33) should confirm the post-load trade-bound state, for example by comparing `Village.TradeBound` before saving and after loading, and own any fix.
